name: rankine_cycle_two_extractions
title: Regenerative Rankine cycle with two extractions and closed feedwater heaters (TESPy)
summary: HP/MP/LP steam plant of the TESPy optimisation tutorial: 200 kg/s live steam at 100 bar / 650 °C, two extractions (20 / 3 bar) feeding two closed feedwater heaters with drain pumps and a desuperheater, condenser with 5 K terminal temperature difference; design point with a documented 2-D sweep replacing the pymoo optimisation.

authors: Francesco Witte (TESPy lead developer) and the TESPy contributors

verification.summary: The unmodified TESPy SamplePlant (base model of tutorial/advanced/optimization_example.py) was re-run in a throw-away venv at the design extraction pressures; 38 common variables agree to <= 1.3e-9 relative except the cooling-water flow (2.0e-3, INCOMP::Water vs Water liquid enthalpy). A sweep end point (10/2 bar) matches to 3e-11. Energy balances close to <= 7e-7.
verification.reference: TESPy SamplePlant design solve (local snapshot ~/git/tespy, commit 19425523, CoolProp 8.0.0), print_results + full-precision results dump
verification.notes: max_rel_diff 2.0e-3 is the cooling-water flow (INCOMP::Water vs Water, explained in README); all steam-cycle variables <= 1.3e-9. Sweep end point p2=10/p4=2 bar: eta_th agrees to 3e-11.
